characterContinuation.newEvidenceReading: 自己を含む公表と訴追、または虚偽を維持する配分の仕事という、選んだ経路に応じた帰結が描かれる。
遅れて出した手紙という過去と、期日どおりに出す手紙の後日談が接続する。
中庭・当番・被害の数という既存の判断材料が両後日談でも使われる。
非開示経路では自分の地下での仕事と閲覧能力を主張する発話が加わり、主人公以外の住民のために働く目的が原文で補強される。両結末で告白の有無がRenとの距離に関係して描かれる。
既存読解を維持。結末での新たな直接描写はなく、その後の仕事・母親は不明。
受諾されて喜べないという反応が追加される。公開時は警告した契約失効が描かれ、受諾時は継続事業の配分をRenも担う。

setupAndConsequenceObservations.observation: 公開経路は自分の署名を含む公表から、自分も訴追され弁明を拒む終幕へ進む。受諾経路は「106対11」を採ったあとKrajcikの提案を受け、終幕がその先の継続的な配分判断を描く。Teoのところで公表を望んだRenが後に受諾することには、Krajcikから新たに知らされた移転資金と雇用提案が間にあるため、単純な人物矛盾として扱わない。

evidence.quote: I walk to the far side, where the forty people are, and I start with my own name.
evidence.speaker: REN

evidence.speaker: ending narration

evidence.quote: [Leave them] A hundred and six against eleven.
evidence.speaker: selected player choice

evidence.quote:
I am not asking you to think I am a good man. I'm asking you to do the determination I am required to make every quarter and make every morning anyway.

evidence.quote:
Come back. Survey Engineer One, my authority, your line. You redraw the boundary honestly, quarter by quarter, and I move the households on the inside of it first. Nobody is told. The contract survives. The money keeps moving.

...Right.

evidence.speaker: REN

evidence.quote: You had already done the sum her way once, on the west side, and found you could live with the answer. That was the afternoon that made this possible. Everything after it was administration.

setupAndConsequenceObservations.limit: Krajcikの自己説明の真偽と、実際の長期移転モデルは未測定。約30世帯/四半期の提案と11年380世帯の数値差はあるが、終幕は臨時予算と予算不足による先送りを明示するため、一定速度の保証との矛盾や追加説明が必須という指摘は残さない。詳細な数量原因を推測して補わない。

setupAndConsequenceObservations.observation: 公開経路では告白後の「慰めない」という態度が、毎日出廷しても目を合わせず、先に本人から聞けたことだけを手紙に書く終幕へ続く。受諾経路では閲覧を保留されることに反発し、自分が人々の呼吸のため地下で働いていると述べる。終幕はRenが彼女を見かけても道路を渡らない距離を示す。どちらも包括的な許しや拒絶へ勝手に置き換えない。

evidence.quote:
Why are you telling me?
 No — genuinely. Why now. Is it so I say something that makes it easier? Because I'm not going to. I don't have that.

evidence.speaker: selected player choice

evidence.quote:
...Yeah.
 Yeah, all right.
 Go and do something with it. That's the only thing that's any use to me now. Don't stand there.
evidence.speaker: NESSA

evidence.quote: Nessa came. She sat at the back with her arms folded and she did not look at you and she came every single day.
evidence.speaker: ending narration

evidence.speaker: ending narration

evidence.quote:
She says it proves they knew. Which — good. Fine. That's what everyone's always said and now there's paper.
 I want to read it.

evidence.speaker: selected player choice

evidence.quote:

setupAndConsequenceObservations.topic: Solの判断と中庭の後日談
setupAndConsequenceObservations.observation: 中庭を保つことを優先した経路では、終幕のSolは感謝ではなく悪化させなかっただけだと数える。閉鎖して公開した経路では、記録に中庭の件も載せ、Solの短い返事と設備の移転、より厳しい当番が描かれる。これらはSolの運営上の物差しに結び付く。災害後の会話での被害数と、その後の設備移転での「誰も失わなかった」を、同じ時点・同じ集団と決めて矛盾にしない。

evidence.quote:
A hundred and six here. Eleven there. The heads pull about nine hundred parts off my courtyard overnight and put about eleven hundred onto Fenn Street. Fenn Street is upstairs-capable; every building down there has a first floor and every one of those eleven people knows to use it. My courtyard is where the water is, the generator is, and the only clear ground for two blocks.
 If I shut the heads, I lose the yard. If I lose the yard I lose the block inside a fortnight.
evidence.speaker: SOL

evidence.quote:
You got some of them. That's the job. The job is not everybody, it has never been everybody, and anyone who tells you it is has not done it.
 You'll want to give me the names of the ones you didn't. Don't. I already have them. I write them down before I need to.
evidence.speaker: SOL

evidence.quote:
It was my yard, Vasko. My yard, at four in the morning, because of three borehole heads that a month ago were doing their job.
 I am telling you that as a fact, not as a knife. I have to be able to say the true shape of a thing out loud or I stop being able to do this.
evidence.speaker: SOL — flat

evidence.quote: The Stacks courtyard is in the record too. You put it there yourself: the date, the three heads, the bar, the wedge, and the name of the person who turned them. Sol did not attend. She sent a note through Marsh that said only *right*, and it is the shortest and least kind letter anyone has ever sent you.
evidence.speaker: ending narration

evidence.quote: The Stacks lost the courtyard in a fortnight, exactly as Sol said they would. They moved the generator to the second floor of Pell and the rota got harder and they did not lose anybody, which Sol has never once called luck.
evidence.speaker: ending narration

evidence.quote: [Leave them] A hundred and six against eleven.
evidence.speaker: selected player choice

evidence.quote:
Four out of four. I have done this for eleven years and I have had four out of four twice.
 I'm going to say the thing I don't say. If you'd been here eighteen months ago with that in you, Cellar Row would have been nine people at a window instead of nine people in a bed.
evidence.speaker: SOL — quiet

evidence.quote:
Fenn Street. Which is not my block, which is why nobody but you and I are going to say anything about it at all.
 Eleven people lived down there this morning. I could tell you the number every week for two years and nobody came. You came.
evidence.speaker: SOL — quiet

evidence.quote: The Stacks held their courtyard through the winter. Sol never thanked you for it, because by her count you had done nothing but decline to make it worse.
evidence.speaker: ending narration

setupAndConsequenceObservations.limit: Solの以前の予測と実際の適応の差は人物の誤りとしても読める。短縮された救助の対象者集合や洪水の厳密な時系列は原文だけでは確定しない。既知のSolロック理由文は指摘対象外。

negativeControls: Teoの同文の手紙を、その一致だけで分岐不整合としない。
Nobody ever knewやtwo Rensなどの詩的な限定を、文脈を捨てた形式論理上の矛盾にしない。
ゲーム内の回想日数や文章上の九分を、短縮driverの末尾の2/3 minutes表示と直接比較して通常プレイの時間矛盾としない。
移動・戦闘短縮下で出た被害人数や暴力への語りを、自然なプレイヤー動機の実証にしない。
本文が意図・予測として述べたことと、後日談が結果として述べたことを区別する。

findings.problem: P119 paragraph 5の実際の取得文「1 of the names you read out were people ...」は、主語の中心が単数の1であるのに主節の動詞がwereになっている。この単数値で表示された一文の数の一致だけが指摘として残る。
findings.why: 回想する一文で単数主語に複数動詞がつき、英語の読みの流れを損なう。意味は理解可能であり、影響をこの一文の仕上げに限定する。
findings.fix: 単数の結果1を含む同等の終幕文で、単数主語と複数動詞wereの不一致を0件にする。補語も当該一人を自然に指す文に整えるか、人数に左右されない構文にする。人数や犠牲者の変更は要求しない。原文読取コマンド: python -c 'import json,sys; e=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["events"]; print(e[118]["paragraphs"][4])' /workspace/scratch/0b7ad82bafe7/narrative-4190137/transcript-en-publish.json
findings.hypothesis: 未検証。人数と周囲の語形が別々に扱われた可能性はあるが、文面生成の実装を読んでおらず原因は断定しない。

evidence.speaker: ending narration
evidence.quote: 1 of the names you read out were people you had carried as far as a stairwell in a filling street four days earlier, and not far enough.

findings.scopeLimit: 今回のpublish経路で実際に出た単数値の英語文のみ。通常プレイの人数・別人数・別言語は未確認。

targetBuild.association: Coordinator-supplied association for the two pinned transcript files.

decisions.reason: 数字の差はあるが、予算によって実績が変わり先送りが続く文脈は原文に既にある。一定速度の保証と長期実績の矛盾ではなく、人物の概算と予算に制限された結果の差として読めるため、説明不足という質の指摘は反証される。
語りの換喩と単複の一致は別の問題であり、換喩としての自然さでは1とwereの不一致を反証できない。短縮取得の制約を踏まえても、この実際の一文に限る英語の不一致は残る。
